about: Every resume of the route from a chapter save finishes, except these halts (tools/resume_check.py; docs/campaign/CAMPAIGN_RUNNER.md#the-runner). Each entry is one halt, where and how it stops (chapter, objective index, objective kind, halt kind, and for a lost battle the battle: event:N or random), the chapters whose resume reaches it, the issue that owns it and the date it was recorded. An unlisted halt fails the check, and so does a listed resume that no longer halts there.

halts.note: Observed on integrated main 166812ec after the normal-opening timing changes (#680): kuran-arrival loses to BlindHead formation 475 after formation 499 leaves Rune down; jut-outfit loses to BlindHead mixed formation 496 after formation 475 leaves Chaz and Rune down. Both patrols begin refuge travel before the fatal encounter; the Edge combat weakness remains owned by #579.

Observed on integrated main 166812ec after the normal-opening timing changes (#680): the Ice Digger loses to formation 132 on the way to the Dezo spaceport, with the human party still standing. This formation and route leg are already documented by #586; the mounted policy's failed-escape risk remains.
